excerpt.zh: 得益于我们在巨型工程研究的进展，我们现在可以在宜居£planet£行星外围修建星环基地了。通过指派一艘£construction_ship£工程船以开始修建。
excerpt.en: Thanks to our recent advances in mega-engineering research, we are now able to construct Orbital Rings around habitable £planet£ Planets. We can begin building by issuing orders to a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.
